Summary.p:
The VanOrmans love to go camping. So cooking outdoors is one of our things.
(Di doesn't like the camping, but she does like the outdoor cooking since she gets to sit back for a change.)

We especially love to do Dutch Oven cooking!
When Ransom was a 11-year-old Boy Scout, he was introduced to Dutch Oven cooking by his Dad. (Grandpa John was his Scoutmaster.) And we have been doing it ever since.
In in all that time, we have gathered several award-winning recipes, and have made up several recipes of our own.
